help.intro: Lumo writes with the AI model on this computer, as ✨ AI on selected text does.
help.fix: corrects spelling, accents, punctuation and grammar
help.improve: rewrites it clearer and more natural
help.summarize: makes it shorter, keeping its key points
help.translate: translates it (LANG: a code like en, es, pt, or a name like English)
help.status: whether Writing is on, which model it uses and where it runs
help.stdin: Without TEXT, Lumo reads standard input. The answer is written to standard output as it comes.
help.langs: Up to 4,000 characters at a time. The model can be wrong: read what it writes.
help.local: Everything runs on this computer with LordOS's local engine. Nothing goes online.
help.exit: Exit status: 0 done, 1 the model failed or took too long, 2 wrong command, 3 Writing is off or has no model or engine, 4 no LordOS session, 5 the text is empty, too long or not UTF-8, 130 interrupted.
err.noText: No text: write it after the command or send it through standard input.
err.tooLong: The text is too long: at most 4,000 characters.
err.lang: Unknown language: {word}. Use a code like en, es or pt, or a name like English.
err.langMissing: Which language? For example: lumo translate en "text"
err.off: ✨ AI Writing is off. Turn it on in Settings → AI → Writing.
err.noModel: No AI model is installed. Install one in Settings → AI → Brain.
err.noEngine: The AI engine isn’t installed. Install it in Settings → AI → Brain.
err.noSession: Lumo needs your LordOS session: run it in a terminal on your desktop.
err.busy: The AI engine is busy. Try again in a moment.
err.timeout: The model took too long to answer. Try a shorter text.
err.denied: Only the user of this session can use its Writing.
status.where: Runs on: this computer, in LordOS’s local engine, in its sandbox. Nothing goes online.
